mapper.select: WITH all_months AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MONTH'), -LEVEL + 1), 'YYYY-MM') AS year_month FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 12 ) SELECT am.year_month AS yearMonth, NVL(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%monitor%' THEN 1 END), 0) AS nk, NVL(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%fxgl%' THEN 1 END), 0) AS fx, NVL(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%audit%' THEN 1 END), 0) AS ck, NVL(COUNT(CASE WHEN t.REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%OperateController%' OR t.REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%AnalysisReportController%' OR t.REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%NbsjZgController%' OR t.REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%CsrwController%' OR t.REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%NsbjZgzzController%' OR t.REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%TblWgzzController%' OR t.REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%TblWghsController%' OR t.REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%TblWgjyYsController%' THEN 1 END), 0) AS zg FROM all_months am LEFT JOIN TBL_USER_REQUEST_LOG t ON TO_CHAR(t.REQUESTTIME, 'YYYY-MM') = am.year_month AND t.REQUESTTIME >= ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -12) AND t.REQUESTTIME < TRUNC(SYSDATE) + 1 GROUP BY am.year_month ORDER BY am.year_month

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%fxgl%' THEN 1 END) AS fx, COUNT(CASE WHEN REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%audit%' THEN 1 END) AS ck, COUNT(CASE WHEN REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%monitor%' THEN 1 END) AS nk, COUNT(CASE WHEN REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%OperateController%' OR REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%AnalysisReportController%' OR REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%NbsjZgController%' OR REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%CsrwController%' OR REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%NsbjZgzzController%' OR REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%TblWgzzController%' OR REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%TblWghsController%' OR REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%TblWgjyYsController%' THEN 1 END) AS zg FROM TBL_USER_REQUEST_LOG

SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%fxgl%' THEN 1 END) AS riskCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%monitor%' THEN 1 END) AS controlCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%audit%' THEN 1 END) AS auditCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%OperateController%' OR REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%AnalysisReportController%' OR REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%NbsjZgController%' OR REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%CsrwController%' OR REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%NsbjZgzzController%' OR REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%TblWgzzController%' OR REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%TblWghsController%' OR REQUESTCLASSMETHOD LIKE '%TblWgjyYsController%' THEN 1 END) AS rectifyCount FROM TBL_USER_REQUEST_LOG WHERE REQUESTTIME >= SYSDATE - 30
SELECT COUNT(1) AS c, BUSINESSMODULE AS b FROM TBL_USER_REQUEST_LOG GROUP BY BUSINESSMODULE ORDER BY c DESC

WITH all_months AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MONTH'), -LEVEL + 1), 'YYYY-MM') AS m FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 12 ) SELECT am.m, NVL(COUNT(t.CREATETIME), 0) AS c FROM all_months am LEFT JOIN TBL_STAFF t ON TO_CHAR(t.CREATETIME, 'YYYY-MM') = am.m AND t.CREATETIME >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MONTH'), -11) AND t.CREATETIME < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MONTH'), 1) GROUP BY am.m ORDER BY am.m

WITH all_months AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -LEVEL + 1), 'YYYY-MM') AS year_month FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 12 ) SELECT am.year_month AS yearMonth, NVL(COUNT(t.LOGIN_TIME), 0) AS c FROM all_months am LEFT JOIN TBL_USER_LOGIN_LOG t ON TO_CHAR(t.LOGIN_TIME, 'YYYY-MM') = am.year_month AND t.LOGIN_TIME >= ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MONTH'), -11) AND t.LOGIN_TIME < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MONTH'), 1) GROUP BY am.year_month ORDER BY am.year_month

WITH months AS ( SELECT TO_CHAR(TRUNC(ADD_MONTHS(SYSDATE, -LEVEL + 1), 'MONTH'), 'YYYY-MM') AS year_month FROM DUAL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= 12 ) SELECT m.year_month, NVL(COUNT(DISTINCT r.OCCUREDDATE), 0) AS fx, NVL(COUNT(DISTINCT b.CREATETIME), 0) AS nk, NVL(COUNT(DISTINCT p.CREATETIME), 0) AS sj FROM months m LEFT JOIN TBL_RISKEVENT r ON TO_CHAR(TRUNC(r.OCCUREDDATE, 'MONTH'), 'YYYY-MM') = m.year_month LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_BUG b ON TO_CHAR(TRUNC(b.CREATETIME, 'MONTH'), 'YYYY-MM') = m.year_month LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_PROJECT p ON TO_CHAR(TRUNC(p.CREATETIME, 'MONTH'), 'YYYY-MM') = m.year_month GROUP BY m.year_month ORDER BY m.year_month
SELECT COUNT(1) AS c, b.BUGPROPERTY AS b FROM TBL_NBSJ_BUG b LEFT JOIN TBL_NBSJ_BUG_CRITERION c ON b.BUGID = c.BUGID GROUP BY b.BUGPROPERTY ORDER BY c DESC
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN LOSSEVENTCATEGORY = 1 THEN 1 END) AS CATEGORY1, COUNT(CASE WHEN LOSSEVENTCATEGORY = 2 THEN 1 END) AS CATEGORY2 FROM TBL_RISKEVENT

SELECT COUNT(1) AS c, CONCAT(YEAR(STARTDATE), '-', LPAD(MONTH(STARTDATE), 2, '0')) AS d FROM TBL_NBSJ_PROJECT WHERE STARTDATE >= ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE, -12) AND STARTDATE < ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE, 0) GROUP BY YEAR(STARTDATE), MONTH(STARTDATE) ORDER BY YEAR(STARTDATE), MONTH(STARTDATE)
SELECT PLANSTATUS AS s, COUNT(1) AS c FROM TBL_TESTPLAN GROUP BY PLANSTATUS
SELECT STATUS AS s, COUNT(1) AS c FROM TBL_ZGZZ_ISSUESILIST WHERE ISSUESTYPE = 1 GROUP BY STATUS ORDER BY c DESC
SELECT STATUS AS s, COUNT(1) AS c FROM TBL_RISKEVENT GROUP BY STATUS ORDER BY c DESC

SELECT s.REALNAME AS type1, o.ORGNAME AS type2, j.RNAME AS type3, TO_CHAR(s.CREATETIME, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS type4, ROUND(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, s.CREATETIME) / 12, 2) AS gl FROM TBL_STAFF s LEFT JOIN TBL_ORGANIZATION o ON s.ORGID = o.ORGID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.USERNAME, REGEXP_SUBSTR(s.ROLEIDSTRS, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) AS rid FROM TBL_STAFF s WHERE s.ROLEIDSTRS IS NOT NULL CONNECT BY LEVEL <= REGEXP_COUNT(s.ROLEIDSTRS, ',') + 1 AND s.USERNAME = PRIOR s.USERNAME AND PRIOR DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE IS NOT NULL ) split_roles ON s.USERNAME = split_roles.USERNAME LEFT JOIN TBL_ROLE j ON split_roles.rid = j.RID WHERE s.CREATETIME IS NOT NULL
